title: filix fragilis
intro: Filix fragilis, commonly known as the fragile fern or lady fern, is a plant species belonging to the family Dryopteridaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Filix fragilis include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which may help to soothe and calm the body and mind. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
